title: Exclude fixed-paid rank-five P104 prefix banks on chart 3→238
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Exact comparator #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

This continuation exhausts all 18 frozen, owner-empty 3→238 public banks for productive roles 325 and 1087 on charts 370 and 375. Both prime-field engines exclude all 18 by full exterior prefix rank. Every original 65521 minor's axes give a nonzero determinant on the independently reconstructed 65537 exterior rows. No selected key remains unresolved. The other 31 keys from #7370 remain outside this test. No suffix, exact unit pairing or physical prototype was needed.

The fixed-paid 2+3 or 3+2 change would keep 110,519 paid positions and raise productive positions from 22,461 to 22,478. The recomputed directed one-edit upper is 0.207666506667591 raw and the optimistic two-role upper is 0.415333013335181. The support test excludes both eligible roles in this scope, so the realized saving is zero.

## Task and overlap

This is the fixed-paid productive `p104-side-correction` continuation of #7370 at `a41edc3ae92332a7a1f1ba90e9ea4901d0530185`. Its catalogue left these 18 keys outside support testing. #7367 uses the same proof method on a different endpoint cohort. The research commit adds only `research/p104-rank-five-chart238-prefix-bound/`. The two existing #7257 commits address the pre-existing CI navigation mismatch documented in #7371.

## Validation

Use CPython 3.12 from a clean checkout.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-rank-five-chart238-prefix-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay authenticates the exact #7370 published manifest, recomputes the signed price with #7298, regenerates both modular receipts and checks all original axes at the second prime. Altered selection and geometry fail. Add `--out fresh-directory` to retain four receipts. Registered-package, committed-byte/source-history, navigation and export checks passed.

## Credit and open next questions

#7370 supplies the catalogue and inherited price. #7334 and #7113 supply the native word and signed caller. #7338, #7298 and #7319 supply admitted invoice, tariff and helper census. #5599, #7367 and #5994 supply split and support precedents. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

The next bounded test is the untouched 17-key 3→233 group on charts 329 and 340. Begin with exterior prefix rank at two primes. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.
